amend.tradingPairTooltip: Enter exchange currency name and select matching trading pair
amend.callbackRatioSpreadIncrementTooltip:
Adjust main order callback ratio/spread (percentage/absolute). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change
Example: Original ratio 10%, enter 2% → new=10%+2%=12%, enter -2% → new=10%-2%=8%, Original spread 10, enter 2 → new=10+2=12, enter -2 → new=10-2=8
amend.ordPxIncrementTooltip:
Adjust main order price (absolute/percentage). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change
Example: Original 10, enter 2 → new=10+2=12, enter -2 → new=10-2=8, enter 10% → new=10*(1+10%)=11, enter -10% → new=10*(1-10%)=9
amend.tpRangeTooltip:
TP price vs order price: absolute or percentage. Example: long at 10, TP spread 2 → TP=10+2=12; TP spread 2% → TP=10*(1+2%)=10.2. Set -1 to skip
BINANCE: Futures not supported
amend.slRangeTooltip:
SL price vs order price: absolute or percentage. Example: long at 10, SL spread 2 → SL=10-2=8; SL spread 2% → SL=10*(1-2%)=9.8. Set -1 to skip
BINANCE: Futures not supported
amend.triggerOrdPxIncrementTooltip:
Adjust trigger and order price (absolute/percentage). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change
Example: Original 10, enter 2 → new=10+2=12, enter -2 → new=10-2=8, enter 10% → new=10*(1+10%)=11, enter -10% → new=10*(1-10%)=9
amend.callbackRatioTooltip:
Adjust callback ratio (percentage). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change
Example: Original 10%, enter 2% → new=10%+2%=12%, enter -2% → new=10%-2%=8%
amend.tpIncrementTooltip:
Modify TP order trigger and price (absolute/percentage). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change. For single TP/SL mode, controls buy side
Example: Original 10, enter 2 → new=10+2=12, enter -2 → new=10-2=8, enter 10% → new=10*(1+10%)=11, enter -10% → new=10*(1-10%)=9
amend.activationPxTooltip:
Adjust activation price (absolute/percentage). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change
Example: Original 10, enter 2 → new=10+2=12, enter -2 → new=10-2=8, enter 10% → new=10*(1+10%)=11, enter -10% → new=10*(1-10%)=9
amend.slIncrementTooltip:
Modify SL order trigger and price (absolute/percentage). Positive adds, negative subtracts, 0 no change. For single TP/SL mode, controls sell side
Example: Original 10, enter 2 → new=10+2=12, enter -2 → new=10-2=8, enter 10% → new=10*(1+10%)=11, enter -10% → new=10*(1-10%)=9
amend.newContractSizeTooltip:
OKX: In spot margin market buy, this is quote currency qty; futures = contracts; otherwise = base currency qty.
BINANCE: Base currency qty.

Plain number = direct set; start with = = Excel formula.
Variables: m = market price, o = order price, s = position size, n = increment count, sz = original order size, cv = contract face value, ls = lot size step (case-insensitive, n starts from 0)

Examples: =sz+10 current+10 / =sz*110% current×1.1 / =sz+n batch increment / =ROUND(sz*200%, 2) current×2 rounded to 2 decimals
Order by amount: =FLOOR(100/(m*cv),ls) (100 = order amount in USDT)

Functions: ROUND / FLOOR / CEILING / IF / SUM / AVERAGE etc.

condition.instIdTooltip:
Position Count: If left blank, it counts the total number of all positions.
Position Size: If left blank, it calculates the total position size of all positions.
UPL: If left blank, it calculates the total profit amount of all positions.
UPL%: If left blank, any position meeting the profit rate condition is considered triggered.
Margin: If left blank, it calculates the total margin of all positions.
Mgn.%: If left blank, any position meeting the margin ratio condition is considered triggered.
Liq. Dist.: If left blank, any position meeting the distance to liquidation condition is considered triggered.
Position Side: If left blank, any position meeting the position direction condition is considered triggered.
Funding Rate: If left blank, detection is not possible; an instrument must be specified.

backtest.title: Strategy Backtest
backtest.noBacktestableWarning: No indicator or time window conditions found in strategy
backtest.disclaimer: This backtest only validates indicator signals + time window win rate. {{count}} condition(s) such as position/balance/cooldown/TV signal are live safety guards and excluded from backtesting.
backtest.timeframeTooltip:
Short timeframes have large data volume and limited download speed, supporting fewer backtest days
Example: 1m max 5 days, 3m max 13 days, 5m max ~6 months, 15m max ~1 year
Exceeding the limit may fail due to long date span — try shortening the start-end range
backtest.timezoneNote: Time window conditions will be converted from {{tz}} timezone to UTC for backtesting
backtest.ftNotFound: Freqtrade not found, please install first
backtest.resultPlaceholderHint: Configure parameters on the left and click Run
backtest.stoplossTooltip:
Maximum allowed loss percentage, auto-close when reached. Negative means loss ratio
Example: -5 means stop loss at 5% loss; -10 means stop loss at 10% loss
backtest.roiTooltip:
ROI exit rules: auto-close when profit reaches the specified percentage after the specified minutes. Add multiple rows, matched shortest time first
Example: row 1 3% @ 0m (close immediately at 3% profit), row 2 1% @ 30m (close at 1% if held for 30 min)
backtest.trailingCallbackTooltip:
Close position when price drops this percentage from peak, used to lock in floating profits
Example: 2 means close when price drops 2% from peak; 5 means drop 5% (looser)
backtest.dryRunWalletTooltip: Initial capital for the simulated wallet, used to calculate returns and fund allocation
backtest.stakeAmountTooltip: USDT amount invested per trade, each position uses a fixed amount during backtesting
